stem_book: In the Vn-method of summing a series whose terms are products of factors in A.P., the numerator is: (a) First term (b) Product of terms (c) Difference of last and first terms (d) Sum of terms
key: c Difference of last and first terms
derived: c Difference of last and first terms
correct_answer: c Difference of last and first terms
reason: Print says 'In the method described' - named the Vn-method in the stem so it stands alone.
work: Tn = (last factor − first factor)/(product of all factors) → numerator = last − first
